item.title: The Inventor
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): History, Comedy

Elevator Pitch: The Inventor is immortal being that is capable of creating everything he wants. He's old almost same as Earth. After so many years he become bored, so he started to travel across world and he ended up in one of the sites of SCP Fundation.

Central Narrative: The Inventor was one of dozen Researchers that were chosed by something that created everything to expand one type of sciences, way before enything living appeard on Earh. Main task was to master the subject that they were given (like biology, chemistry, writing, physics etc.). They needed to create a absolute form of something from their subject. The Inventor was given a hunger for creativity. He needed to create more and more. All of Researches made their tasks and after that, they could choose one wish. Everybody chosed death becouse they lived so long that they had enough. Only The Inventor didn't complete this task becouse his creativity never ended, after creating somthing that he was sure that this is absolute, he camed up with even better idea.

Additional Notes: On this SCP, I'm working with friend who also has account (M-The-Writer).
